fields.name: First Dynasty
fields.description: The earliest unified Egyptian dynasty, beginning with Narmer/Menes. Amenti from this era remember the first unification of Upper and Lower Egypt.

fields.name: Fourth Dynasty
fields.description: The pyramid builders. Amenti from this golden age remember Khufu, Khafre, and the construction of the Great Pyramids at Giza.

fields.name: Eleventh Dynasty
fields.description: Reunification of Egypt after the First Intermediate Period. These Amenti remember bringing order from chaos.

fields.name: Twelfth Dynasty
fields.description: The classical age of Egyptian literature and art. Amenti from this peaceful era are often scholars and diplomats.

fields.name: Eighteenth Dynasty
fields.description: The dynasty of Hatshepsut, Akhenaten, Tutankhamun, and great imperial expansion. These Amenti remember Egypt at its zenith.

fields.name: Nineteenth Dynasty
fields.description: The Ramesside period, including Ramesses II the Great. Warriors and builders from an age of monumental construction.

fields.name: Ptolemaic Dynasty
fields.description: Greek rulers of Egypt after Alexander. These Amenti bridge Egyptian and Hellenistic worlds, often multilingual and cosmopolitan.

fields.name: Modern Awakened
fields.description: Amenti who first awakened in the modern era, or who have fully adapted to contemporary society across many incarnations.
